F.name: Jenkins, Leah
F.team: F8/ We're Sexy & We Throw It

predictions: Took a minor step back to a 17-9 record last week, but at least the week's results reminded me that the more things change, the more they stay the same… Of my 9 incorrect picks, SEVEN would have flipped or tied on a single dart. Yep, that's how things go around here. Grrr. That brings me to 35-17 (67.3% correct) so far, which is decent, but I definitely still want to bump that up a bit. I'm going to need some help from D and F divisions though (as I'm only 4-4 in each of those two to this point).

Match of the week: (E Div.) Runs with Corks @ Ton 80 Proof. Oh, man, the new guys on these teams have delivered big so far. And thus, these two are racing Dartifacts at the front of E, and they have a huge showdown here that will turn the early E season into a two-team race instead. I'm super impressed with both teams so far, but I think I'm feeling the Corks just a tiny touch more. So, I'll go Corks here, 14-10.

Match #2: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Wing & a Plaque. Just like in E (see the match prediction above), B has three undefeated teams so far. And while I do love the Secrets and what they've done so far, you know from my preseason picks that I think these two are serious B contenders. And as much fun as Wing's run has been… this one is to the Humpers, 14-10.

Match #3: (G Div.) Shark Shooters @ Flight Club. This one doesn't have two undefeated teams in it, but the Shooters have only lost to what I think is the other top G team. I still have faith in the Shooters to make a run, so despite the early season show being put on by Club's newcomer McKenna Manske, I have to go Shooters here. It will be close, 13-11.

Match #4: (C Div.) Mulligan's Mafia @ Nine Lives. The Niners are 2-0. The Mafia is 1-1, but with a loss to what I expect to be a serious C race contender. It's one of the two undefeateds against the top team with a loss… so this match is sneakily huge. Week 14 finishes could be a bit determined by what happens tonight. Oh, this is tough… Niners, 13-11?

Match #5: (D Div.) Main Street Mayhem @ Menace 2 Sobriety. M2S just barely got nipped by She Said, or this would be another battle of unbeatens. I still like Menace could be a big factor in this race, but I also can't ignore Mayhem's strong start. Let's ride the Mayhem, 13-11.

Match #6: (F Div.) Nein Mark @ Bangin the Wire. Another pair that is only a dart short of being two 2-0 teams. I already expected these two to finish close to each other in the standings, and nothing so far has changed that opinion. I'll roll with the Nein Mark run, 14-10.

Match #7: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ The Outlaws. A is deep this season, and I expect the #4-7 teams to wage an all-out war among that group. I admit that I'm a little stunned that Darty Minds started out 0-2, but there's no way they go 0-3, is there? Darty Minds, 15-9.

Match #8: (D Div.) That's What She Said @ Bottoms Up. While She Said has certainly flashed the possibilities that come with their newly hybridized roster, Bottoms is the team that I think set the bar in D. I'm certainly still in my seat on the Bottoms bandwagon, 16-8.

Match #9: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Red-eye Rangers. Ok, I don't have any idea what is up with the Cheapies. Those guys are good shots, but they're somehow one of two teams leaguewide below 16 points after two matches (and it's 4 less!). Rangers, I guess? 14-10.

Match #10: (F Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Sofa Kings. Here we are in the drama-land that is F division (7 of 8 matches so far have been 13-11 scores!). The idea of any team running away here feels nigh impossible. I think I'll take Dartness, by a score of… 13-11. Duh.
Match #11: (E Div.) Rippin Darts @ Dartifacts. Wow, Rippin has had two very different weeks so far. But you know who hasn't? Dartifacts, that's who. They look to be on a mission. 'Facts, 16-8.

Match #12: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Pints & Points. Every team in C has 19+ points, and only the Possee has reached 30 so far. It's clear that 1-1 teams are still very much in the title hunt. P&P, 13-11.
